_: The one look (PLAN.md Phase 2 item 1; retargeted by Mac to Warcraft III Reforged at the RTS camera: chunky readable shapes, rich saturated colour, bold house colours, crisp light). look.gd reads it. on: the switch (or --look=one); off keeps today's light. sun_elevation: degrees above the horizon (25-35: long soft shadows). sun_color / horizon_color: the warm key (about 4500 K) at height and near the horizon. sky_contribution: how much of the shade's light comes from the sky (the rest is ambient_color: the cool blue fill in the shadows). lut: the colour grade (assets/grade/storybook.png, made by tools/make_storybook_lut.py: lifted warm mids, quieter greens, cool shadows; empty: none; today's golden-hour LUT only browns). saturation, contrast: the gentle S-curve after AgX. exposure. haze_color: the warm distance haze. kit_tints: the free kit's materials re-graded by name (a multiply on their colour: earthy terracotta roofs, honey stone, darker oak, deeper leaves; kit.py's unify table). ssao / ssil: soft contact shadows (radius, intensity, power) and bounced light. haze: the volumetric haze's density near the ground (fades out as the camera pulls back) and the distance fog's density.
_target_was: Foundation/Tiny Glade (storybook.png, earthy tints); kept: assets/grade/storybook.png

politics._: The political map (docs/review/political-map.md; target docs/art/target/02-realm.jpg; CK3's political map mode in Warcraft III's colours). on: the switch (or --politics=on). hold: how strongly a house's land carries its colour, by its favour band (the bridge's reading): loyal heartland strong, cold land fading. stripes_below: a hold under this stripes the land in its rival's colour (the first house it's at war with): slipping. wash_near / wash_far: the colour's strength at town zoom and from far off (times hold). own_mix: how much of the house's flat colour goes over the land's own brightness (0: a hue only, 1: flat paint). border_bright: the border line in the house's own colour, brightened; border_px: its width in screen pixels. stripe_width: the stripes' width in tiles. map_from / map_to: the camera's height over the ground (game units; a town view stands about 5-9 up, the map about 35) between which the wash, the band and the stripes come in; below map_from the land stays natural (about a seventh of wash_near) and only the border line shows (target 01-town: no red ground at roof height).

team._: Team colour (team_colour.gd; Mac's North Star, docs/art/target/02-realm.jpg; Warcraft III): the kit materials whose names start with these keys take the holder's colour, by how much (roof tiles strongly, wood trim lightly; walls, brick and stone not at all). on: the switch (or --team=on / --team=off). saturation: the house colours pushed bolder (WC3's team colours). A town that changes hands eases to its new colour over a season.
